name: obstacle
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated production sprite for an iOS puzzle board.
Reference image: use ONLY the dark square obstacle tiles in the CENTER phone's board as the exact visual design reference. Recreate one of those obstacle blocks faithfully at high resolution: square charcoal cast-metal plate with softly rounded corners, a fine raised dark steel bevel around the square, four small recessed screw heads at its corners, a raised circular dark steel medallion in the middle, and a large clearly recessed black diagonal X cut into that medallion. The X is the obstacle identifier and must be visible. Top-down almost orthographic view, symmetrical geometry, very slight thickness visible at bottom, soft upper-left warm light, refined miniature toy-game material, delicate clean grain. Matte gunmetal gray, not blue, not silver chrome, not gold, not rusty. The whole square plate occupies 90% of square canvas, centered with transparent margins and a tiny soft contact shadow. Real transparent alpha background. Single block only, no board, no tile behind it, no text or other symbols. Match the reference closely rather than redesigning it.

name: delivery
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated production sprite for the delivery destination tile in an iOS toy repair puzzle.
Use ONLY the small golden robot-face destination tile in the CENTER phone board of the reference. Recreate it as one refined square token: a warm golden-yellow enamel socket frame, softly rounded square corners, inset amber recess, four tiny brass corner screws, a small cute red-and-ivory wind-up robot FACE medallion centered in the recess, with two glossy dark eyes, cream inset face and a tiny smiling mouth, round brass ears and red antenna. Head only, no full body. Exact frontal view nearly orthographic, slight toy-like thickness at lower edge, upper-left warm highlights, clean tactile rounded 3D game-art matching reference. Entire token including antenna within 90% square canvas, generous transparent margins, subtle contact shadow. True transparent alpha background. No numerals, letters, labels, UI, additional objects, no workshop backdrop. Avoid heavily distressed metal or elaborate ornament. Clearly a golden delivery socket with friendly robot face.
